## Section 0 of the spec, copied verbatim (spec lines 40-51)

>
> - **What it is.** `pairA-qg-operator` RESULTS.md:18 (pushed in SpaceKitti/Grok 757af61; unchanged at 1fe72c2) reports a total angle of 3.999997π ≈ 4π at each of two tips.
>   - The tips are the two exceptional points ±ε_EP of the 2×2 Pair A matrix spectrum.
>   - The surface is the n = 2 branched double cover of the round S² (CONE_TIP_NOTE §2-§4b) [identity].
>   - The period τ_E = 4π/ε_EP was set by hand from the handoff: "[by construction, given τ_E = 4π/ε_EP from the handoff]" (RESULTS.md:18).
> - **What it is not.**
>   - It is an excess, not a deficit.
>   - It is not made by strings or tension.
>   - It is not a solution of any field equation.
> - **So it is not a string cone, and it supplies no SM1 input** (`SM1_INPUTS.md`, "Where 'the cone formed' actually rests"). This run is the first hive run that puts tensioned objects (vortices) at a conical tip.
>
